name: Fuyume Airi
source:
Fuyumi is the "winter Grace". She met Mitsuki and senpai by accident when they rescued her after a bad fall on ice.

Fuyumi is a very reserved person who has been able to control her emotions all her life, but her sudden love for the senpai has made a mess in her head. Wanting to claim him no matter the cost, Fuyumi decides to perform a love spell.

She doesn't like to waste energy on expressing unnecessary emotions, tries to approach everything rationally, and logically, but in the end she just suppresses herself. She's like a boiling pressure cooker whose contents are being held back by the lid. Sooner or later it risks exploding...

Fuyumi is a gambler and one time she spent all her money trying to get her favorite toy out of a claw machine. She never succeeded and was once again convinced that it's better not to feel strong emotions.

[i]"I was ready to do anything for love".[/i] 

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753200]official art-book[/url]]
